title: customer-success
text:
customer-success

emma_cs: FYI — HK customer KaiPay reporting a clear change in Chinese-language behavior after last night's model swap (v2.1 -> v2.2-opt). They say Mandarin responses are more formal and there's unexpected Cantonese code-switching. Also they're intermittently seeing 401s when re-running some requests.

kai_customer: Sending their minimal repro + examples. They say this started ~2026-03-15 22:10 HK time after the deploy. Sample convo (customer prompt -> model reply):
```
# BEFORE (previous model):
Prompt: "用粵語回覆：如何重設密碼？"
Response: "收到，請按設定 > 密碼，跟住指示就可以。"
\n# AFTER (v2.2-opt rollout):
Response: "我們已經收到您的請求，稍後會為您處理。有需要請提供帳戶號碼。"  <-- more formal, traditional characters, and not the expected casual Cantonese.
```

kai_customer: Also showing the 401 payload they saw when they retried the same request twice:
```
{"error":"Unauthorized","status":401,"message":"invalid api key"}
```

kai_customer: They attached the exact curl they used to repro: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-v2-zh-opt","input":"用粵語回覆：如何重設密碼？","region":"ap-east-1"}'
```

emma_cs: Marking P1 for this account (revenue-impacting). They want rollback or mitigation ASAP.

jia_ml: Thanks — grabbing the request logs for that customer id. A couple of quick asks: 1) can you confirm the exact model_id value the customer used (full name + tag), 2) did they hit any fallback routing (we changed routing for small sequences in the swap), and 3) do we have the raw request payloads/response tokens?

sahil_eng: Repro attempt from my laptop using the curl above — I see the same style shift on v2-zh-opt. No 401s locally.

sahil_eng: I did get a 502 earlier from a different endpoint which coincided with a token refresh job (not sure related).

li_engineering: deploy-bot shows the canary promotion at 2026-03-15T21:55Z -> rollout-bot shows full-promote at 22:05Z. Could be model build/config difference between canary and full.

deploy-bot: "deploy: model redwood-v2-zh-opt promoted to prod (canary->full) by @ci/pipeline at 2026-03-15T22:05:12Z"

jia_ml: Hypothesis: tokenization/normalization change in v2.2-opt may bias script selection (simplified vs traditional) and register formality. We also changed a locale fallback rule (if lang detection confidence < 0.6 route to zh-general). If zh-general has different training mix it could cause this shift.

jia_ml: Quick action plan: reproduce minimal prompt set across model variants and log tokenized outputs + lang-detection probability. Can one of you share the customer's full model string and sample request IDs?

emma_cs: Provided customer request IDs xJk9, xJk10, xJk11 (attached). Also asked for a temporary mitigation: can we pin KaiPay to previous model until we finish debug?

li_engineering: We can route customer to previous model via a per-customer routing override. Need approval from infra for a quick policy change — will prepare a patch.

rollout-bot: "notice: scheduled temporary route override for customer KaiPay -> redwood-v2-zh-stable at 2026-03-16T00:10Z if approved by infra"

jia_ml: To reproduce locally: use this script (tokenizer debug flags enabled) and compare token sequences: 
```
# run tokenizer debug
python ./tools/tokenize_debug.py --model redwood-v2-zh-opt --input "用粵語回覆：如何重設密碼？" --emit-tokens
```

sahil_eng: Also investigating the 401s reported by customer — early suspicion is intermittent API key rotation on their side combined with our edge cache returning cached 401 for a short window. I'll pull edge logs.

kai_customer: Appreciate the rapid response. They're ok with a short routing to previous model while you debug, but asked that we keep them in the loop for any auth-related findings.

emma_cs: Next steps: (1) infra to approve routing override, (2) ML to run tokenization/lang-detect comparison and share delta by EOD, (3) eng to check edge logs for cached 401s and report root cause, (4) CS to confirm the temporary rollback once ready.

li_engineering: Assigned -> I'll open the routing-override PR and ping infra.

jia_ml: Quick note — I'll run a small eval set of 200 HK/Cantonese prompts to quantify regression and paste results in this thread.

sahil_eng: Found a line in edge logs where a stale auth-cache returned an old error response for ~40s window around 22:06Z — likely explains customer 401s on retries. Sending logs to #eng-infra.

emma_cs: Thanks all. KaiPay is watching this thread. Will update them after we have the routing patch and the ML delta. :thumbsup:
